# STY001 `multiple-modules`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="opt-in" />

A file defines more than one module or submodule.

## Why

One module per file makes the file name tell where a module lives, keeps recompilation cascades
small (every module of a file is rebuilt when any of them changes) and lets a build tool order
compilation per file without false dependencies.

## Reported

```fortran
module grid
end module grid
module solver
end module solver
```

## Preferred

```fortran
! grid.f90
module grid
end module grid
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[STY001] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = STY001` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `S211` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
